name: yati-lms
description: Local development only: starts the server and the two web apps (student, admin) from the repo root. Each app keeps its own package.json, and deployment builds each from its own folder (see DEPLOYMENT.md), so nothing here reaches production. Ports are pinned because FRONTEND_URL (5173) goes into emails such as the guardian approval link, and two Vite servers started together would otherwise race for it.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:student & npm run dev:admin & npm run dev:tts & wait
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix yaticorp-lms-server && npm install --prefix yaticorp-lms-student && npm install --prefix yaticorp-lms-admin
scripts.dev:tts: cd yaticorp-lms-tts && (test -x .venv/bin/uvicorn && .venv/bin/uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8008 || echo '[tts] voice service not installed: see yaticorp-lms-tts/README.md')
